description: Tool to retrieve a Stripe promotion code by its ID. Use when you need to get details about a specific promotion code including its associated coupon, usage restrictions, and redemption statistics.

inputSchema.description: Specifies the promotion code ID to retrieve.

promotion_code_id.description: The unique identifier of the promotion code to retrieve, typically starting with 'promo_'.
promotion_code_id.title: Promotion Code Id

inputSchema.title: RetrievePromotionCodeRequest

name: retrieve_promotion_code

Coupon.description: Coupon object associated with the promotion code.

amount_off.description: Amount that will be taken off the subtotal of any invoices.
amount_off.title: Amount Off

applies_to.description: Contains information about what products this coupon applies to.
applies_to.title: Applies To

created.description: Time at which the object was created, measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code if amount_off is defined.
currency.title: Currency

duration_in_months.description: If duration is 'repeating', the number of months the coupon applies.
duration_in_months.title: Duration In Months

livemode.description: Has the value true if the object exists in live mode or false if in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

max_redemptions.description: Maximum number of times this coupon can be redeemed in total.
max_redemptions.title: Max Redemptions

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object.
metadata.title: Metadata

name.description: Name of the coupon displayed to customers.
name.title: Name

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'coupon'.
object.title: Object

percent_off.description: Percent that will be taken off the subtotal of any invoices.
percent_off.title: Percent Off

redeem_by.description: Date after which the coupon can no longer be redeemed, in Unix seconds.
redeem_by.title: Redeem By

times_redeemed.description: Number of times this coupon has been applied to a customer.
times_redeemed.title: Times Redeemed

valid.description: Whether the coupon can still be applied.
valid.title: Valid

Coupon.title: Coupon

CouponAppliesTo.description: Products that this coupon applies to.

products.description: List of product IDs this coupon applies to.
products.title: Products

CouponAppliesTo.title: CouponAppliesTo

Restrictions.description: Settings that restrict the usage of the promotion code.

first_time_transaction.description: Whether the code can only be used by customers without prior successful payments.
first_time_transaction.title: First Time Transaction

minimum_amount.description: Minimum order amount required to redeem the code, in smallest currency unit.
minimum_amount.title: Minimum Amount

minimum_amount_currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for minimum_amount.
minimum_amount_currency.title: Minimum Amount Currency

Restrictions.title: Restrictions

RetrievePromotionCodeResponse.description: Contains detailed information of the retrieved promotion code.

active.description: Whether the promotion code is currently active and can be used.
active.title: Active

code.description: The customer-facing code string that customers enter at checkout.
code.title: Code

created.description: Time at which the object was created, measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

customer.description: ID of the customer that this promotion code can be used by (null if unrestricted).
customer.title: Customer

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp specifying when the promotion code expires (null if no expiration).
expires_at.title: Expires At

id.description: Unique identifier for the promotion code.
id.title: Id

livemode.description: Has the value true if the object exists in live mode or false if in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

max_redemptions.description: Maximum number of times this code can be redeemed (null if unlimited).
max_redemptions.title: Max Redemptions

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object.
metadata.title: Metadata

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'promotion_code'.
object.title: Object

times_redeemed.description: Number of times this promotion code has been used.
times_redeemed.title: Times Redeemed

RetrievePromotionCodeResponse.title: RetrievePromotionCodeResponse
